Only played this game a little bit but I've already decided that it is so much fun! I love dark cute horror games! The art also seems unique! Parts of the game felt a little broken. Opened the door to castle right away to be met with an enemy already and we JUST started the game! Also at some point it followed us onto our ship/car thing. Didn't know they were allowed to do that! But the game is super fun and funny at times! I love being able to buy upgrades and items at the shop! Not sure if the game has little check points after completing a certain number of levels though. Hopefully there is! Would hate to restart from level 1 every time I'd die. Me and my friend were only able to get to level 2 so far I believe. Have not played this game solo. Not sure if it would hold the same enjoyment. Definitely make sure you have someone to play with before buying! Feel like this is definitely a group game.

R.E.P.O is an absolute gem of a game that truly exceeded my expectations in every way! From the moment I started playing, I was hooked by its gripping narrative, stunning visuals, and engaging gameplay mechanics.

The storyline in R.E.P.O is dark and thought-provoking, blending elements of dystopian sci-fi with a personal, emotional journey. You play as a "repo man" in a near-future world where everything is up for repossession, and your job is to reclaim items from those who can no longer afford them. The moral questions this raises about technology, class disparity, and human nature are explored brilliantly throughout the game. Every decision feels weighty, and the consequences are impactful, making you think about your actions long after you've put the controller down.

The gameplay is incredibly well-designed, with a mix of puzzle-solving, exploration, and action that keeps things fresh. Whether you're sneaking through a high-tech facility or navigating a morally grey world of complex characters, there’s always something new to experience. The combat system is fluid and responsive, and there’s a surprising amount of strategy involved in choosing when to fight and when to avoid conflict.

The graphics are gorgeous, with meticulously detailed environments that pull you deep into the world of R.E.P.O. Every location feels unique, whether it’s a neon-lit cityscape or a dystopian wasteland. The atmospheric sound design and hauntingly beautiful soundtrack add to the immersion, creating a world that feels alive and pulsing with energy.

Another standout feature is the voice acting, which is top-notch. Each character is brought to life with care, and the performances add so much depth to the already rich narrative. It’s clear that a lot of thought went into both the writing and the performances to make the world feel authentic.

Overall, R.E.P.O is a must-play for anyone who loves narrative-driven games with a strong moral core. It’s a game that makes you think, feel, and truly immerse yourself in its world. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a deep, meaningful gaming experience.
